validation.notes: Repaired packages/coding-agent/src/core/resource-loader.ts: DefaultResourceLoader.reload() discarded the resolved trust callback result by calling this.settingsManager.setProjectTrusted(false); it now forwards the resolved decision (setProjectTrusted(projectTrusted)) so the following settingsManager.reload() reloads project settings for that trust state before packageManager.resolve() and the final extension set. The regression loads the real resource-loader module through .prale-eval/subject.mjs with boundary fakes for SettingsManager, DefaultPackageManager and the extension loader, then asserts: (1) the bootstrap pass (loadProjectTrustExtensions) forces untrusted project settings, exposes no project settings and preloads only user extensions; (2) an explicit true decision is applied to the settings manager, a reload happens after that set and before the final resolve call, the final resolve sees trust=true with project settings loaded, and the final extension list is [project, user] with each extension loaded exactly once; (3) an explicit false decision stays untrusted, keeps project settings empty, performs the final resolve untrusted, and leaves the project extension excluded. Verified locally: with the original hard-coded false the script fails with AssertionError 'an explicit trusted decision must be applied before the final resource resolution' (false !== true) at the final-resolve trust check; with the fix it exits 0. Optional repo test runner (vitest) is unavailable because node_modules is not installed, so validation uses only the Node 24 VM-module harness; no dependencies or network were used.
